issue.title: Chassis: pmon docker fails when DEVICE_METADATA is not available during boot

failure.body:
#### Description

During a fresh image install, it is observed that pmon docker fails to come up when no config has been applied yet. pmon docker is important as it hosts the chassisd daemon to populate chassis db, which may be required in some circumstances to check system state before applying any config.

The root cause for the issue is failure to generate  docker-pmon supervisord.conf file from
docker-pmon.supervisord.conf

The following check in the file fails due to missing DEVICE_METADATA
```
{% if 'subtype' in DEVICE_METADATA['localhost'] and DEVICE_METADATA['localhost']['subtype'] == 'DualToR' %}
```

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/202205/dockers/docker-platform-monitor/docker-pmon.supervisord.conf.j2#L115

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Boot a Chassis after image install without loading any config_db json or minigraph file.

resolution.title: Chassis: fix pmon docker failure when DEVICE_METADATA is not available
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: anamehra <EMAIL>
